ja349:1.1: N' eva itthīsu sāmaññaṃ na pi bhakkhesu sārathi, ath' assa sandhibhedassa passa yāva sucintitaṃ.
ja349:2.1: Asi tikkho va maṃsamhi pesuññaṃ parivattati yatth' ūsabhañ ca sīhañ ca bhakkhayanti migādhamā.
ja349:3.1: Imaṃ so sayanaṃ seti ya-y-imaṃ passasi sārathi yo vācaṃ sandhibhedassa pisunassa nibodhati.
ja349:4.1: Te janā sukham edhanti narā saggagatā-r-iva ye vācaṃ sandhibhedassa nāvabodhanti sārathīti.
